meta.title: Find in conversation
meta.description: Adds a find bar to the open conversation. Press Ctrl+F (Cmd+F on macOS) to open it; pressing it again refocuses the field and selects the query instead of closing it, the way a browser behaves. Type and every match in the visible message text is highlighted using the same literal, case-insensitive, whitespace-flexible matching the Host's own session filter uses; step through hits with Enter / Shift+Enter, F3 / Shift+F3 or Ctrl+G, and close with Esc, which returns focus to where it was. When nothing matches, the bar clicks the Host's own "load earlier" control to page further back (up to 8 pages), so history that was never scrolled into the window is searchable too; reaching the start of the conversation and exhausting the 8-page budget are reported as two different states. The count is the real hit total; at most 4000 hits are painted and the bar says so explicitly instead of silently dropping the rest. Pages with no conversation open (settings, plugins) say so rather than reporting no matches. It matches only text the conversation column has rendered: it does not read the session event log, so unrendered content such as raw tool-call arguments or request headers is out of reach; it does not match the labels inside transcript controls; and nothing crosses session boundaries.
